text:
sophia: Heads-up: we're updating quota & free-credit policies next month. Key changes: free credits expire after 6 months (down from 12), and small accounts will get a one-time 30-day grace buffer for the first expiration cycle. Well also add an opt-out toggle for auto-apply credits in billing settings. Docs: https://redwood.internal/billing/credit-policy

harry: Why shorten from 12->6? Any customer outreach plan?

sophia: Two reasons: reduce long-tail accounting complexity and align with usage patterns. Comms plan: targeted emails to affected accounts + blog post + in-console banner 72h before. Finance will run a reconciled report.

maria: Any invoice format changes?

finance-bot: Minor invoice line-item changes: "Credit Applied (GRACE)" tag for grace credits. No change to core metering. For disputed expirations, file billing ticket and we will review case-by-case.

support: Adding KB and canned responses. Include steps: check billing UI -> credits tab, verify applied flag. ETA: EOD.

ops-bot: Also rolling out a quota-warning header for SDKs: X-Redwood-Quota-Warn: <percent> when used >80% of monthly quota. We'll add dashboard alerts and a sample curl in docs.

maria: Rollout timing?

sophia: Launch Mon 09:00 PT staged over 24h. Pre-notify impacted customers Wed AM. If you have objections, please raise before Friday EOD. TL;DR: free credit window trimmed, one-time 30-day grace for this cycle, opt-out toggle, new quota warning header, comms & KB in flight. :memo:
